journeys.name: Equities: search, filed statements, watchlist

steps.name: Open Equities Research
One press on the Apple example: its filed revenue chart
Search for “apple”
Open Apple’s company page
Financials: the filed statements, and where a figure came from
Add to watchlist
The watchlist lists it

journeys.name: Equities screener: filter, results, company

steps.name: Open the screener
Templates: a price-based one says why it is off for filed companies
Filter: return on equity of at least 20
Open a result

journeys.name: Equities compare: two filed companies, saved and reopened

steps.name: Open Compare
Add AAPL and MSFT: a column each, from their SEC filings
They open on the fiscal year both hold, FY2025
Each company’s latest: every figure names its year
Save this comparison
Clear the page’s selection
The workspace lists it
Open restores both columns

journeys.name: Property on a phone: enter, save, reopen

steps.name: Open the property calculator on a phone
On a phone, enter a price, a rent and a deposit, one section at a time
Save it from the action bar
It is listed with the saved properties
Reopen it: the figures as typed, not a sample

journeys.name: Property: calculate, change, save

steps.name: Open the property calculator
Enter a price, a rent and a loan
Change the rent: the cash flow and the yield move
Change the loan: the cash required moves
The optional ELS panel: open it, the roles stated, copy the brief, the clipboard matches the panel, the link opens the ELS enquiry page (els.alumax.pro/contact) and the deal is unchanged
Save the property
It is listed with the saved properties
Proposal hides the sale’s costs, proceeds and profit until unlocked
The Scenario Lab’s ELS link opens the calculator’s panel and keeps ?real=0

journeys.name: Property Quick model: typed figures move the answer, the full model holds the same deal

steps.name: Open the calculator: the Quick model
Type a price and a rent, no Tab: the answer moves
Open the full model: the same deal and the same figures
Other running costs: opened in place, a box changed, the answer moves
A reload keeps the view the address names

journeys.name: Property landing: the Scenario Lab moves, compares and saves

steps.name: Open /property: the Scenario Lab on the sample deal
Move the rent: the monthly position and the net yield follow, the repayment does not
Move the rate: the repayment follows, the net yield does not
Moving tenure changes the repayment
Compare by cash flow: A, then B
Save the property, then B as a scenario
Export is disabled until saved, then opens the proposal
It is listed with the saved properties
Choose Commercial and Subsale, set a target: the price that makes it work is solved
Choose Auction, enter the Proclamation’s terms: the effective cost is read

journeys.name: Property evidence: record a comparable, use it in a scenario

steps.name: Open the comparables register: the guided flow, an empty register
Record a transaction price, step by step: its locality, source and date
Use it in the Scenario Lab: it is named in the comparables
Enter an asking price: the price gap names it with its source and date
Choose Auction: your comparables’ median is the value it implies

journeys.name: Property new development: a comparable and a schedule, the premium read

steps.name: Open /property: the Scenario Lab on the sample deal
Choose New development: the premium is Unavailable without a comparable
Enter a completed comparable and the dates: the premium is read
Apply the Form C template and space it to VP: construction interest is worked out

journeys.name: Property commercial: the four rents, a comparable rent recorded, sustainability and the 12-month reserve read

steps.name: Open /property: the Scenario Lab on the sample deal
Choose Commercial — whole shoplot: sustainability and the reserve are Unavailable
Enter the contract rent, its expiry and the model rent: the yield both ways
Record an achieved rent and use it in the Lab
Read the sustainability line and the 12-month reserve

journeys.name: Property across routes: a subsale condo, an auction condo and a shoplot side by side, the lens switched, the order kept

steps.name: Open the Lab on a saved subsale condominium
Add an auction condominium and a shoplot: each column on its own route
Switch the lens: the columns stay A, B, C
Save the comparison and reopen it

journeys.name: Property refurbish or not: four options built from your figures, the payback read, the order kept, saved

steps.name: Open the Lab on a saved property
Enter Refurbish and Upgrade: the cost, the rent each adds, the months without rent
Read the improvement payback
Save the figures to the property

journeys.name: Property costs: lines with their sources, the report in four parts, actual against modelled, a schedule imported

steps.name: Open the Lab on a saved property
Enter cost lines with sources
Open the report and see the four sections
Record an actual and see the difference
Import the synthetic schedule

journeys.name: Property flow: an opportunity recorded with its source, opened in the Lab beside a saved property, the comparables visited and the what-if kept, saved

steps.name: Save a property in the Scenario Lab
Record an opportunity with its source and date
Open it in the Scenario Lab: a column beside the saved property, its provenance with it
Move its price and answer Auction: a what-if, nothing written
Visit the comparables: the work in the Lab is named, not saved
Press Evidence: the record’s source, in the register
Resume in the Lab: the what-if intact
Save it as a property: tied to the record, its provenance kept

journeys.name: Property journey bar: the property, how it is bought, its evidence and its moves on every page; Evidence lands where its figures are confirmed

steps.name: A first visit to the comparables: the sample deal, how it is bought and its sample figures, Explore marked
Open the Lab from the steps: its evidence and its moves under them, the property and how it is bought in its heading
Move the price and answer Auction: the line counts the moves, the evidence stays the sample’s, nothing written
Visit the comparables: the line names the Lab’s work, Auction and its moves, with Resume
Press Evidence: the calculator, at the figures still the sample’s, Evidence marked
Replace the rent on the calculator: the count follows the review, 9 of 10
Resume in the Lab: the moves intact, the evidence 9 of 10, Save in the line gives the keyboard to the Lab’s Save

journeys.name: Property map: Kuching’s placed schemes from the list, positions only, opened in the Scenario Lab

steps.name: Open the Kuching scheme map: the map or the locality diagram in its place, the list and the attribution
What the map draws holds no figure
Find a placed scheme in the list: its confidence, its evidence and NAPIC’s rows
Open the Scenario Lab from it: the column on the nearest listed locality, nothing written

journeys.name: Scanner: build, save and evaluate a setup

steps.name: The dashboard shows the example on a generated series
Its replay holds the rule only at bar 66
The dashboard’s four steps, in order, with their states
Open the setup builder
Build a condition: price crosses above its 20-bar EMA, on AAPL
Save the setup
The setup’s page shows it
Evaluate it: the page says there is no price history here
The dashboard’s first step counts the saved setup

journeys.name: Workspace: a returning reader resumes in two presses

steps.name: Open Apple’s company page
Open My Dashboard: a first visit
Its “Recently opened” row opens Apple
Save a property of your own
Open the homepage
Press “Open workspace”: the reader’s work first
Saved properties tile reads 1
Continue reopens it: the second press

journeys.name: Tools’ records: a Cash Wheel contract and Trading Index evidence, printed from Print & share

steps.name: Open the Cash Wheel
Enter a contract: the obligation, the shortfall and the payoff at expiry
Reserve the cash: the put reads cash-secured
Open the Trading Index
Load the §14 worked example: it returns 38, 35 and 77
Record a stronger daily price structure: the trend regime rises and the change is logged
Open Apple’s company page
Print & share lists the contract, the trend evidence and Apple
The Cash Wheel’s decision record opens from Print & share with the contract’s figures
The Trading Index’s decision record opens from Print & share with the evidence’s figures
Apple’s research report opens from Print & share

journeys.name: Property registers: a comparable recorded, a locality shaded, a property listed

steps.name: Open the comparables register: empty
Record a transaction and a rent: each listed with what it rests on
Open the area screen: Kuching’s localities, each unrecorded one hollow
Record Tabuan’s flood exposure: its point is shaded, an unrecorded one stays hollow
Shade by achieved rent: the rent recorded for Tabuan shades it
Open the opportunity register: empty
Record a property: it is listed with what is known and what is not
It is still listed after a reload

journeys.name: Investment case, alerts and portfolio: a case checked, a threshold crossed, a holding listed

steps.name: Open Tenaga’s investment case tab
Start a case: it is listed, its condition checked against the latest data held
Write the case in a sentence: kept after a reload
My Alerts lists the case’s breached condition as research, with its source period
Set a price threshold: crossed, and listed with its source once price moves are shown
Scanner matches: the page says the scanner’s record cannot be seen here
Add a holding: listed, its price return worked from its cost, its case marked written

journeys.name: Your data and settings: closes pasted, listed and exported; scanner settings kept

steps.name: Open Your data & settings
Paste closes: read, and listed once the page reloads
Export: the prices, and everything you have made, carry the closes
Open the scanner’s settings
Change three scanner settings: each holds after a reload

journeys.name: Backup and restore: your work exported, the browser cleared, the file imported twice — each item back once

steps.name: Save representative items
Export everything: the file holds each item, and the page says when
Clear this browser, as a new one
Import the file: each item back, once
Import it again: nothing doubled
Reopen the restored property: A and B as saved, its version shown, not a sample

journeys.name: Scanner example: its replay, bar by bar, against the generated series

steps.name: Open the Scanner: its example at bar 66
Replay to bar 65 by the keyboard: Held becomes Not held, each figure the series’
Replay to bar 66 again: Not held becomes Held
Replay to bars 60, 20 and 14: each condition reads what the series allows
The how-it-works example replays the same

journeys.name: Investment case: started from a company, a default confirmed, written in your words, reopened from Saved work, restored from a backup

steps.name: Open a filed company
Start an investment case: a draft, its defaults marked suggested
Confirm the review date: its mark goes and the others stay
Reopen from Saved work and write the case in your words: the research when saved, with its versions
Export everything: the file holds the case as saved
Clear this browser, restore the file twice: the case back once, as saved, and an older case with no version added

journeys.name: Correction case: reported from a company page, saved in this browser, reopened after a reload and copied — nothing sent

steps.name: Open Apple’s company page
Report a data error: what is recorded is shown first
Save the case: “saved in this browser. Nothing has been sent”
Copy it: the clipboard holds the case
Load /corrections afresh: the case is listed under its id
Open it: the same case, copied again
No request carried the case or left the site
